decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy, overwhelming opponents with a combination of powerful creatures and artifact spells. By turning artifacts into creatures with spells like Ensoul Artifact and combining them with aggressive creatures like Voldaren Epicure and Spyglass Siren, this deck aims to quickly deal damage and control the board. The inclusion of cards like Shrapnel Blast and Torch the Tower provides additional removal and reach, while the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring gives the deck added flexibility and consistency.

The deck focuses on using the Transmogrify combo to quickly and efficiently summon powerful creatures onto the battlefield. Utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Reckoner Bankbuster, and Case of the Stashed Skeleton, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with unexpected and game-changing creature plays. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Duress allows for disruption of the opponent's strategy, while Fatal Push and other removal spells help maintain control of the board. Additionally, the deck has Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional support and consistency.

The main concept of this Pioneer deck is to use a combination of cards like Thoughtseize, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Fear of Missing Out to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up resources with cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Bitter Triumph, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Parhelion II to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger adds versatility and resilience to the deck.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm opponents and deal damage efficiently. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional flexibility and consistency to the deck's game plan. The key strategy is to establish early board presence with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, while using burn spells like Heartfire Hero and Monstrous Rage to finish off opponents. The addition of Slickshot Show-Off and Callous Sell-Sword provides extra reach and versatility in combat, making it a potent aggressive deck in the Pioneer format.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly and aggressively bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard by casting multiple spells in a turn. This is achieved through a combination of cheap spells like Fiery Impulse and Opt, as well as card draw spells such as Treasure Cruise and Artist's Talent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Picklock Prankster and Brazen Borrower to control the opponent's board while pushing damage. The inclusion of Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City add additional threats to close out the game quickly.

This control deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to continually search for powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes a wide variety of creatures with varying abilities and power levels, providing versatility in different board states. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad adds extra value by flickering creatures and permanents. With a mix of removal spells and land ramp, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents by generating incremental advantages throughout the game.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Overlord of the Balemurk to support the combo, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Bitter Triumph to control the board. The deck also includes cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Fear of Missing Out for additional pressure and disruption. Overall, the key strategy is to quickly establish the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main idea of this UW Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan while building up resources and advantage through cards like Dovin's Veto, Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, and Memory Deluge. The deck focuses on removal spells like Portable Hole and Supreme Verdict, as well as land disruption with Field of Ruin. The goal is to outvalue the opponent with efficient threats like The Wandering Emperor and March of Otherworldly Light, while controlling the game with counterspells and card draw.

The main concept of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells to enable the quick return of Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard to the battlefield. Utilizing a mix of cheap spells, card draw, and disruptive spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and card advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe allows for efficient removal of threats on the opponent's side of the battlefield, while also contributing to the overall game plan of fueling the graveyard for Arclight Phoenix recursion.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells. The key strategy is to play efficient threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize. The deck also utilizes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to control the board. By applying early pressure and maintaining control of the game, this deck aims to finish off the opponent swiftly before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive Spirits while disrupting the opponent's game plan with tempo-oriented spells. By utilizing creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller, along with cards like No More Lies and Enduring Curiosity, the deck aims to maintain board control and pressure the opponent to make difficult decisions. The mix of white and blue mana sources allows for a versatile range of plays, while key cards like Supreme Phantom and Skyclave Apparition provide additional support and removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disruption through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. It also utilizes the companion mechanic with Jegantha, the Wellspring for added value. The deck includes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Torch the Tower to keep the opponent's board in check. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Tree of Perdition and Voldaren Thrillseeker to close out games quickly. The mana base is consistent with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to support the aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Greasefang and Parhelion II to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Bitter Triumph to control the game and protect the combo pieces. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's various colors and facilitate the casting of the key cards. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently using the combo pieces to create a winning board state and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix for repeated attacks. It includes plenty of cheap spells to trigger the Phoenix's ability, as well as card draw and filtering to ensure a steady stream of spells. Hall of Storm Giants offers a powerful finisher, while Picklock Prankster can disrupt the opponent's strategy. Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe provide removal options, and Galvanic Iteration can generate extra value from powerful spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and repeated Phoenix resurrections.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to continuously tutor for powerful creatures and synergistic spells to control the board and outvalue the opponent. By sacrificing smaller creatures or cards with little value, the deck aims to find powerful threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to dominate the game. Additionally, the deck includes a variety of versatile removal spells and creatures to deal with threats as they arise. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficient resource management and maximizing the advantages gained from Enigmatic Incarnation's ability.

The deck revolves around controlling the board by utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to search for powerful creatures and disruption spells. The deck also includes a wide range of legendary creatures and spells to provide flexibility and options for different situations. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and card advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the color requirements of the deck and ensure consistent access to all necessary resources.
